title: Remaiten_Botnet_Investigation_ea6
description: Investigate and respond to the Remaiten botnet activity on the network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and potential unauthorized access. Your task is to investigate and respond to this incident.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the victim host with the following credentials:
- Host: victim (192.168.80.100)
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content:
You have SSH access to the victim host with the following credentials:
- Host: victim (192.168.80.100)
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content:
Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.

Question: What is the name of the suspicious service that is beaconing to an external server?
levels.solution: Check running services and look for unusual network connections. The suspicious service is named 'bot-beacon.service'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check running services and look for unusual network connections.

levels.title: Identify Flood Service
levels.content:
Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic.

Question: What is the name of the service generating the flood of network traffic?
levels.solution: Investigate systemd services and look for unusual network activity. The service generating the flood of network traffic is named 'bot-flood.service'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate systemd services and look for unusual network activity.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content:
Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot.

Question: What is the name of the timer unit responsible for the persistence of the suspicious service?
levels.solution: Examine systemd timers and look for services that start automatically. The timer unit responsible for the persistence of the suspicious service is named 'bot-beacon.timer'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine systemd timers and look for services that start automatically.
